provenance: Related by family in the project brief that founded this archive. To be re-captured in Larry's own words.
text: He remembers his organization as the 118th AOD — Aviation Operations Detachment. He describes the organization as relatively small, approximately 110 men, including radio operators and pathfinders. Some personnel reportedly required special clearances.
researchNotes: The designation "118th AOD" is remembered terminology and may not be exactly correct. Candidate organizations to research include the 118th Aviation Company and Aviation Operations Detachments generally.
